terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == -1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
explanation: Active only at GO. Magnitude is driven by the last trial having reached S2 and been rewarded (prev_state + prev_reward == 3), but mostly when that reward is fresh: much larger when the trial before was unrewarded, larger still when the two trials before were both unrewarded; a rare a1->S2 reward adds extra. Rewards at S1, unrewarded trials, and repeated S2 rewards (activation decays over successive rewarded S2 trials) give near zero. The free fit adds that the boost is weaker when the unrewarded trial before was itself at S2 (stronger after a failed S1 trial), and small belief and window-start terms. Residual misses: window-first trials where prev_state is unknown. Observed-only terms; no future variables.

issues: The claims hold. Profile residuals at GO are +0.435 after a1 S2 r, +0.162 after a2 S2 r and about -0.09 after every other previous-trial pattern. D1 and D2 are about 0.

The recorded short form scores test R^2 0.412. Without the last_is('a1 S2 r') term it scores 0.404, so the rare-reward boost is real but small (weight +0.17). The unrewarded-history terms carry most of it: 0.375 with only the fresh-reward term, 0.404 with both tv-reward terms. This fits 'larger after two unrewarded trials' (weights +0.67 and +0.59).
The claim that the boost is stronger when the unrewarded trial before was at S1 checks out but adds little (tv('state',-2)==1 term: weight +0.14, test 0.411).

Misses on the recorded form show a uniform over-prediction of about -0.075 at GO in every non-S2-rewarded cell. That is an artefact of the GO timing baseline: none of the terms says the feature is about 0 at GO otherwise. Replacing the a1 term with (phase == GO) * (prev_state + prev_reward != 3) raises test R^2 to 0.428 (dev 0.446). After that the remaining systematic error is under-prediction after a1 S2 r (+0.148) and window-start trials (prev_state unknown, +0.03).
Window-start misses cannot be fixed from observed variables: a (prev_state == -1)*(prev_reward == 1) term gets weight 0.06 and adds nothing (0.4095).
